title: The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!

sense.text:
“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”. Babylon is the United States of America. America is not written in the Bible; it is called Babylon because it carries the characteristics of ancient Babylon.

Look at the back of a dollar bill: an eagle on one side and the ancient pyramid on the other, the eyeball, the all-seeing eye of Ra. That is ancient Babylonian symbolism, and it was well thought out. When they declared their independence in 1776 they wrote Novus Ordo Seclorum, new world order, and Annuit Coeptis, our enterprise. That was done in pride. There is mysticism on the back of that dollar bill that goes all the way back to ancient Babylon, the same as Easter, which is not in the Bible but an ancient Babylonian pagan custom of a fertility god. Bunny rabbits don’t lay no eggs. Everything on the back of that dollar bill is pride.

The eagle is the symbol God gives for the fourth beast. It holds a branch on one side and arrows on the other, because they make war against other countries, and they do it in pride.

And this is what is going to happen to the man now leading it. He put up an image of himself as Jesus, with the American flag behind him, the military with eagles’ wings and ships, healing people. He ain’t healing nobody. All he is doing is destroying the lives of his own people and the other countries of the world with his pride. This is the same man who called the Obamas monkeys, who called Michelle a monkey in heels. That is a prideful man.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: that is how they got to where they are. They took America by bloodshed, violence and force. They massacred the indigenous people, stole this land from them and pushed them onto reservation camps. Then they dragged Negroes to America against their will for hundreds of years and used us for free labor. When slavery was abolished in the 1800s they kept abusing us, and a hundred years later they put a bullet in Martin Luther King’s head while he was asking for civil rights. Then they tell us, if you don’t like it, get out. Go back where? To Africa, which you are still destroying as we speak? Those are prideful people. And when we point out the conditions they created and the harm done to us, they turn around and call us racist. They will not stop, because the pride of thine heart hath deceived thee.

“With a continual stroke”: they never stop. They are always looking for a reason to start a war.

“He that ruled the nations in anger”: that is what you are seeing as they help Israel bomb the Gaza Strip and wipe out the Palestinians, and declare war on Iran. Even his own officials asked why go to war with Iran when they did nothing. They have been saying Iran may have nuclear capability for thirty years, and every president decided not to attack, until this prideful president, on the advice of the Israelis, decided to bomb them. Now gas is going up, food is going up, soldiers are put in harm’s way, and they talk of bringing back a draft, because the logical white people are saying they will not send their precious sons and daughters to fight a war started on pride. So they take advantage of the disenfranchised blacks and Latinos with promises of education and a better life. Read your Bible: going to war, there is a high probability you come back dead.

As soon as he got in office he put on tariffs, and even his own people told him they would not hurt anyone. He did not hurt one country. He hurt his own American people: prices went up on everything, businesses closed, mom and pop shops shut down, and he knew it, but he did it in pride, while the other countries laughed at him. “Is persecuted, and none hindereth.”

“The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.” When America goes down, the other countries of the world are going to sing, everyone except the people who love America the way it is.

“Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.” Even the trees will be happy. Since America has been taken down, nobody is chopping down trees anymore. They would clear a whole forest for their luxury and their benefit. They don’t care about nature, agriculture, the ocean or the air we breathe, so God says even the trees will rejoice when they go down.

“Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming”. Right now we are in hell, but God is going to remove hell off of his people to meet the leaders of the earth at their coming. Their destiny is hell. Hell is a condition, and it is also described as a place, and it awaits them because of their pride.

Not because we don’t like them. We don’t teach anyone to hate white people; that is what they try to project onto us. Their own white counterparts have a problem with them: people from his own cabinet are resigning, and he is not listening to his advisers or his war counselors, who tell him this is not a good decision. When we say it, we are racist; when white people say it, it is okay.

People like to say, you people are nothing, you don’t have no money, you’re walking around in purple clothes talking about the Bible. We know something you don’t know. Your ass is going to hell. Hell is a real place of torment and suffering and you are going there. I would not trade places with you for all the tea in China or all the gold in Fort Knox. That is your destiny, because God said it and we read it.

“It stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth”: all the high-ranking officials in positions of power, God is waiting to devour them in hell. “It hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations”: they are all sitting in positions of power, and God is taking them all out. The real king is the Messiah, the black Messiah, who is going to set the world on fire. He is King of kings and Lord of lords, and every knee shall bow.

“All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we?” We are going to tell them, you have become weak like we was. We will no longer be the monkeys, the jigaboos, the coons. They are going to become weak, and you are watching them fall through this man’s pride.

“Art thou become like unto us?” They will be regular people. No more glorified, no more sitting on high.

“Thy pomp is brought down to the grave”. Your pomp is your pride, and his pride is going to bring him down to the grave. He is going to find out what it means to be a slave. When you have pride, the place for you is the grave.

“And the noise of thy viols”: the noise of thy viols is your mouth. “The worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.”

The grave and hell are symbolic of the condition you are in, of the grave you go to, and of the spiritual place of torment that God has waiting. There are Israelite camps that want to imagine there is no place of torment, and every time we teach on hell and torment they do classes against it. Why? Because they are wicked, and they are going there also. The scriptures say the wicked will find torment, a place of suffering.

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” Right now America is in its heaven. Heaven is rulership, but the Bible says they are going to fall. “How art thou cut down to the ground”: God is going to bring them down to the ground.

“Which didst weaken the nations!” Who has been weakening all the nations? America. We are not saying it because we don’t like them. America is the greatest place on the face of the planet, but how did they get great? From weakening other nations: robbing, stealing, killing, plundering, enslaving and destroying. And they still do it today.

“For thou hast said in thine heart”: this is what they are thinking in their heart, their soul, their mind. “I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”. We are the stars of God, the twelve tribes of Israel, and their throne is sitting on us. Don’t let nobody tell you that you ain’t nothing. They have to stay on top of us, because that is the only way they can keep ruling; once we open our eyes, we rise. So whatever is going on with China, Russia, the Arabs, Iran or Hezbollah, they say keep these people down: don’t let them read that Bible, don’t let them understand God, throw everything at them including the kitchen sink.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation”: that is us. We are the mount of the congregation. “In the sides of the north”: America, because the bulk of the Israelites are here. That is why the truth started here, and why the bishop now says to teach our brothers and sisters scattered in the north, the south, the Caribbean, Africa, Australia, all over the world, and wake them up. If you have not heard it in America, it is because you don’t want to hear; in other places they have cut off communication and have less freedom and less access to information. That is why Christ said to go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel, but the focus is to sit upon the congregation in the north.

“I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.” That is why he put the picture up, to show himself with spiritual power and with healing. This is how he feels: he feels he is Jesus Christ, the Messiah, and God himself. That is why it has the American flag, the eagle, the soldiers with wings, the planes. We did not make this up. Somebody in his office sat down and said Donald Trump is God, he is Jesus. They could at least have given him Jesus’ head, but they kept the blonde wig on. The Statue of Liberty, the soldiers looking up to him, the nurses as if no one can do it but him, another praying on the other side, and a light in his hand as if God gave it to him to heal. This is the pride of thine heart hath deceived thee.

“Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.” That is his future. God said he is going to bring him down to hell, and his own people can tell. That is why they are building underground bunkers and stockpiling food. They are saying, you are dragging us down to hell, you are bringing us to the brink of World War III. He is not listening to nobody, because he is moving in his pride.

“They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble”: is this the one who had everybody in fear? The Iranians are saying that now: no peace talks, we are not opening the Strait of Hormuz, we will do what we want. China is telling them it has special interests in Iran and will not sit back and let them be destroyed, and Russia is assisting them. This is no longer us pointing out what they are doing; this is the reality of why this Bible is real. This is not what is done on Sunday, where you give the pastor your money; this is the true teaching, the true prophecies coming out of the Bible.

“That did shake kingdoms”: he destroys any place he wants. He went into Venezuela and took Maduro out, threatened Cuba, put Cuba in darkness with sanctions; went to Haiti and took Aristide out of office; went to the Gaza Strip and wiped out a place of 2.5 million people. Say we are making this up. This is what is happening before your eyes. They sent out a threat to destroy a whole place with millions of people and wipe them off the map, back to the ancient days, and even his own people asked, how do you threaten to wipe people out of existence? The pride of thy heart hath deceived thee.

“That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?” He gets everybody he wants in subjection to him and indebted to him. If you don’t play, he makes you pay. All the other countries on the earth are prisoners to the United States of America.

“All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house. But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit”. This is the future of the pride of America at this man’s hand.

precepts.why:
When Christ came “into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.” There were demons in them, and the demons recognized real: “What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?”

There is a time appointed when everybody who is evil, Israelite or non-Israelite, is going to pay. Don’t let these Israelite groups make you think you are going to escape judgment for going against what God has to say. They keep saying even the wicked of Israel will not be punished, and they have no scripture to paint that picture.

“So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.” The evil spirit needs a vessel to inhabit. “And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.” So the Lord has a place where the evil spirit goes to suffer torment. That is the whole point.

An Edomite once argued, what type of God would create a place called hell, nothing but eternal suffering and damnation and pain? What type of God would not? There are people walking the earth who don’t care about you, don’t care about death, don’t care about prison, who will kill your whole family and laugh about it. So there has to be a punishment extreme enough for the people who disregard life, a mind above the human mind that says, I got something for you that you are going to care about. It is called hell. If there is no hell, no place of suffering and torment, then God is not feared. God has it prepared, so don’t let nobody make you think you can do whatever you want.

The old One West teaching says all Israel is going to be saved, because they don’t understand the chapter. “I say then, Hath God cast away his people?” Why did Paul open the letter that way? Because of the conflict between the northern and southern kingdom. The Jews thought God was not dealing with the northern kingdom. “God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin”: that was the southern kingdom. “God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew.” In the Old Testament God told the northern kingdom, you are not my people, yet in the place where it was said unto them, you are not my people, there it shall be said that they are the children of the living God.

“For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery”. Those Israelite camps are ignorant of this mystery. The mystery is that God is dealing with both the northern and the southern kingdom, which is why the whole chapter is about them being grafted back in. If you say you are an Israelite and you come from One West and still don’t understand this chapter after all these years, you are an idiot, and God is not dealing with you; God has not revealed this understanding to you. “Lest ye should be wise in your own conceits”: you are wise in your own conceit, making things up.

“That blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.” God blinded a portion of the Israelites in part. He blinded the Jews to the understanding of salvation in Jesus Christ so that the gospel could be preached to the northern kingdom, those Gentiles, so they could come in.

“And so all Israel shall be saved”. One West breaks that down to say all twelve tribes are going to be saved, even if you are wicked, a murderer, an adulterer, a thief: when all is said and done God is going to save you. There are leaders of Israelite camps pulling this scripture to say you are not going to hell. That is not what Paul was talking about. Start from the beginning of the chapter: the Jews thought there was no salvation for the northern kingdom Israelites living as Gentiles, so Paul concludes that both, all Israel, can be saved.

So there is a hell, the hell is real, and if you go against God you are going into it. Anytime Deacon Malachi goes into hell, they come out doing videos laughing that he keeps talking about hell. They know that if there is a hell they are going in there, because even though they are Israelites they are wicked: they teach things contrary to the Bible, they have an evil congregation, and they cannot bring them to repentance, so they don’t want to know there is a death sentence.

Look at the man in his pride: he called Pope Leo weak because the Pope told him to look for a way to peace, and when asked why, he answered about people arrested during COVID. What does the Pope have to do with COVID? That is a stupid, prideful answer. He is the first president in history to disrespect the Pope, and even his own advisers ask how you disrespect the Pope. The Vatican is no innocent; it was built on bloodshed and crime. But the Pope is calling for peace, and he wants war.

He says he does not want a country to have a nuclear weapon. Guess who does not want other people to have weapons? The people who want to remain in control. They rule by the sword, and God said they would. When Isaac gave out the blessings he said to Esau, “Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above”. That is why they live in the best places: they took it by force.

“And by thy sword shalt thou live”. That is why they don’t want anybody else to have a nuclear weapon: a nuclear weapon is a sword, and they are only in power because they have the ability to kill, destroy, disfigure and harm anybody who comes against them. That is why he calls the Pope weak for calling for peace.

And see how crazy they are: if you launch a nuclear bomb at people, the others with nuclear weapons who see how crazy you are will shoot at you, and that is how the Bible says the world is going to end. He is not logical, he is prideful, and what he is trying to prevent is what will bring forth his demise. People are now opening their eyes and saying, we put a madman in office.

sense.text:
“Be not righteous over much”. A lot of people break this down to say there is no such thing as being too righteous. To be righteous over much means nobody can correct you: you think you know everything and you don’t see nothing wrong with yourself.

“Neither make thyself over wise”: you think you are smarter than everybody else. “Why shouldest thou destroy thyself?” When you get to that mindset, you bring destruction on yourself, because nobody can tell you nothing.

That is how you see Donald Trump moving. Nobody can tell him nothing. He is breaking every law. He does not care about the judicial system, about other countries, about our politics or about declarations of peace. He does not understand what took place in COVID; he is just making stuff up.

“The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God”. When you pull God out of the equation, the only thing left for you is pride: you think you know everything and nobody can tell you nothing.

“And his heart is turned away from his Maker.” You no longer care about your creator, your maker. All you care about is yourself, what you want, what you feel and what you think.

“For pride is the beginning of sin”. That is where sin starts, in pride. You don’t care about nobody else; nobody else matters but you; you don’t want to hear what anybody else has to say, because you want things done your way.

“And he that hath it shall pour out abomination”. That is why everything he is doing is abominable on the earth, everything that comes out of his mouth. He can’t stop typing, can’t stop tweeting, stupid thing after stupid thing every day, and people look at him and say, what is wrong with this guy? He does not even say it wasn’t him. He says yes, it was me, and let me explain why, because you people don’t know, I’m smarter than you. He puts his own logic to the stupidity coming out of his mouth. Everything you say and everything you believe is abominable.

“And therefore the Lord brought upon them strange calamities”. That is what you are seeing: strange things happening. When they declared the war he said it would be over in a week, and it has been over a month. He did not know Iran could do that, that there were bombs that could reach that far. His war counselors told him to leave these people alone, and now he is looking strange: you have 72 hours to open the Strait of Hormuz, you have three days, you have ten days. He is looking crazy. So the Pope came in and told him this is not going your way, and now the Pope is the bad guy for asking for peace. Even when white people come to their senses and say, let us try a different way, Trump does not want to hear nothing they have to say.

“Why standest thou afar off, O Lord?” That is how we feel, like God is not with us. “Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?” Because he said he would hide himself, and in our affliction we would seek him.

“The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor”: that is what you are seeing, a wicked man persecuting the poor.

“Let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.” Whatever he is imagining to do to us is going to happen to him; he is going to be taken in the devices he imagined. But understand, things are going to get bad for us before they get better.

“For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire”: every time he opens his mouth he is boasting of his heart’s desire, and that is why America is going to be set on fire, because of Trump’s desire.

“And blesseth the covetous”: he blesses anybody around him who is covetous. That is why he has yes men around him. “Whom the Lord abhorreth”: when you have that spirit, God hates you. That is what it means to abhor.

“The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God”. He cares nothing about God. That is why he can easily say, you like this Jesus Christ, I know you think he is black, but I am your Christ. For him to put up that picture, which somebody took time to put together, and say that is me, shows he has no respect for the Most High God and his son. But he will soon be on the run.

He will not hear anything the Pope has to say. The Pope is trying to tell him, let us at least act like we want peace: we have stolen enough, we have robbed all the countries, we have destroyed the Caribbean and Africa, we are the richest people on the planet with all the gold and all the wealth. And Trump says, hell no, you are weak.

“God is not in all his thoughts.” Don’t ever think for a second that this is a place that cares about God. He is never in their thoughts.

God hates people who are filled with pride. “Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee”: always keep the fear of God on you, because in the end you are going to get God’s goodness.

“Which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee”: trust in God. Don’t trust in the people who are big, bad and prideful, because they are going to fall. Their time is temporary. The only bad man is God. “Before the sons of men!” Don’t think anybody is better than God. No man is better than God.

“Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man”. What we know is a secret. We are the Israelites learning a Bible they took away from us and told us was not our book. They made God white, Jesus white and the people of the Bible white. Now we have found out the secret, that they ain’t right: God’s chosen people are not white.

“Thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.” They are speaking evil against us, but God is going to keep us in a secret place from the evil they declare against us.

God hates pride. “Pride is hateful before God and man”. When you meet somebody who is prideful, even if you don’t say it, you feel it: I don’t like this person. You don’t tell them to their face, because a lot of times you don’t want to deal with their pride or go back and forth with them. But God hates it, and man hates it.

“And by both doth one commit iniquity.” When you are full of pride, by both you commit iniquity.

“Because of unrighteous dealings”: America was built with prideful and unrighteous dealings. And almost all the countries were built on unrighteous dealings, because they enslaved the children of God. We put a lot of emphasis on America because of the cargo slave ships and how powerful America is, but the other countries were established on the blood, sweat and tears of slaves too. Moses warned us that we would be scattered to the four corners of the earth, and all the nations of the earth had us as slaves.

“Injuries, and riches got by deceit”: the riches gotten by deceit were from enslaving the children of Israel, and God has punishment for every single nation that played a part in the enslavement of the Israelites.

“The kingdom is translated from one people to another.” That is why all the kingdoms of the earth are going to lose their dominion, and the one kingdom that is going to stand is the kingdom of the twelve tribes of Israel. That is why they don’t want you reading this Bible: they are going to lose control of your soul when God fulfills his goal to get the kingdom back to the twelve tribes of Israel. Because God hates pride. These people forgot what they did, but God has remembered.

precepts.why:
“Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured”. All they that devour thee are all these other nations. They devoured us, and that is why they are sitting on top. Because pride is hateful before God and man, they will be devoured: they are where they are because they devoured the Israelites and used us for free labor.

“And all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.” That is the kingdom translated from one people to another.

So don’t let anybody put you down and tell you that you are nothing right now. The Bible is your future. The Bible is your hope.

sense.text:
“The fear of the Lord is to hate evil”. Once the fear of the Lord is inside of you, you are supposed to hate evil and pride. We have been conditioned to be filled with pride. We get things and rub them in other people’s faces, or we put down our own people. When we excel in this wicked kingdom we want everybody to see it; we want to be accepted by the white man and we look down at our own people. You don’t see the other nations rubbing their riches in other people’s faces.

“Pride, and arrogancy”: don’t be like them. You are supposed to hate evil, pride and arrogancy, because that is the way our people are. We listen to rap music, and what do they brag about? My house, my car, my watch, how many girls I’ve been with, champagne bottles. Frivolous things with no meaning, of no bearing to God. God hates that, and you are supposed to hate it too.

“And the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.” God hates it even when you talk that way, in pride.

What we are learning as Israelites is to love our neighbor, our wives and our children; when one suffers, we all suffer. America is going to suffer by itself, because the other nations are pulling away. Trump asked for help and they said, you didn’t talk to us when you did this, you are on your own. We are the opposite. We are bringing ourselves to a place of humility so that God can raise us up. So we have to hate evil, hate pride and hate arrogancy.

“A man’s pride shall bring him low”. That is what you are seeing right now. This man was on top of the world when he was elected president, and people were shooting at him. The last time a president was shot at was Reagan, in 1981. A lot of people say this one was faked, to boost his numbers and make people think he is invincible. Whether it was faked or real, you hear nothing about the kid who shot him: no trial, nobody brought to justice, only people saying don’t investigate it. How did the kid break down the gun so fast and run through the woods? Everything sounds fake, and the only way you would do something like that is through pride.

“But honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.” So we have to remain humble. You will watch the world in its pride and see a lot of prideful people thriving and successful. Always remember to stay humble. The Lord will exalt you in due time.

“There take thy pastime, and do what thou wilt”: you can have your fun and do what you want while you are on this earth. “But sin not by proud speech.” God listens to your speech, and some of you speak things that are sinful.

“And for these things bless him that made thee”: always remember that you have a creator. Don’t turn into a hater; remember your creator. “And hath replenished thee with his good things.” God replenished us with the things we have on this earth. We owe it all to God.

“Whoso feareth the Lord will receive his discipline”. God is correcting us right now, and some of you in your pride don’t want to receive the correction. Donald Trump is in the position to make our lives miserable because we are being corrected by God. So it is important that we look at the pride of Donald Trump, even though it affects us and the whole world, and see that this is discipline from God. People will say, if there is a God, why do you live like you live, why don’t you have this or that, and use it as justification not to follow our God or listen when we speak.

“And they that seek him early shall find favour.” That is what we are doing. We are seeking God early. We are not waiting until we are broken and destroyed and about to die. Don’t wait until the whole world is falling apart; seek him early so you can get the favor from God.

“He that seeketh the law shall be filled therewith”. That is why we teach our people to follow God’s laws. Other denominations call us legalists. No, this is why we follow the laws: we went wrong with God by doing our own thing.

“But the hypocrite will be offended thereat.” That is what Donald Trump is: a hypocrite, offended at the service of our God.

“They that fear the Lord shall find judgment, and shall kindle justice as a light.” We cannot bring forth justice on our own. Donald Trump makes it clear: we have the greatest military, we can bomb anyone we want at any time, look at our navy, we dropped big bombs on Iran and have bigger bombs. You hear him talking and think, this guy is an idiot. You better shut your white mouth. What comes out of his mouth is just pride and arrogance.

But God says to us, they that fear the Lord shall find judgment. We don’t need no bombs. Your arms are too short to box with God, Mr. white man. We don’t need no military and we don’t need no money. All we need is to be filled with the law, which is what we are teaching our people, and you call it evil. We put fringes on, tell our women to dress in skirts and dresses and cover their heads, tell the men to grow the beard and honor the Sabbath and keep it holy. That bothers people, though we are doing nothing evil.

We are that light shining now. When we bring forth God’s judgment, God brings forth justice. He says, how can I let these holy people be destroyed by these evil people? They are coming forth into my light, so it is time to set things right. That is why we keep God’s law: things are going to get better for the people who keep God’s law and walk in his light.

“A sinful man will not be reproved”. There is nothing you can tell these people to correct them. Even in the congregation you speak to people over and over and they don’t get it; they always say it is you: you keep coming for me, you just don’t like me, why are you attacking me, I did nothing wrong. In their heart they believe they can sin and win, so they will not listen to reproof. Keep talking to the same brother over and over? Dismiss him after a while; you are wasting your time. Don’t chase them, replace them.

“But findeth an excuse according to his will.” With Donald Trump, all that comes out of his mouth is excuses. He will never admit he did anything wrong; it is always somebody else picking on him. That is why he disrespected the Pope: he could not consider for a minute that maybe he made a bad decision. He puts on the red MAGA hat and explains, let me tell you why I did it, it’s not what you think, it can never be me. That is what happens when you deal with a sinful man. On Clubhouse the men were told, stop reading scriptures to them. They already showed what type of person they are; throw them out of the room. You showed them every scripture and they gave you every excuse.

Even the people in his office tell him, this is not how we fight wars, not how we mediate with countries, not how we handle our finances. There is no money for Meals on Wheels, for government schools and for the elderly, but he is rebuilding the White House with the grandest ballroom you ever saw and talking about Melania’s dress, while the world is at war and gas prices are going up. It is a slap in the face, with the funding cut to schools, transportation and health care and millions losing their health care. He did the longest government shutdown in presidential history, and TSA workers and officers were not getting paid. He didn’t care. The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee.

He got white people killed: the white lady sitting in her car trying to stop ICE from throwing people out like monsters, and the white man who came out to stop them from pushing a lady to the ground. ICE killed them both, and he got his puppet Noem to say it was justified. Notice they are not showing ICE deporting people on the news anymore, now that white people are seeing white people get killed. He started a campaign against the people who helped build this country and do the jobs nobody else wants, and he did it out of pride. The gangbangers, drug dealers and criminals, target them and throw them out; but grabbing a little kid with a Spider-Man book bag, beating people in their cars, kicking in houses with no warrant, changing the laws to do these things, that he did in pride. And it is backfiring in his face.

The same is true in your house. You keep telling your children something and they don’t listen. Wait until they are of age and throw them out, and let the real world humble them; then they will realize they should have listened to their parents. That pride will have them thinking, I did nothing wrong, you are always picking on me, you are mean, while you are doing everything to help them. In the body too, the same names keep coming up, counsel after counsel. Don’t chase them, replace them. If you want the body to grow, let these wicked people go, because they will affect everybody else. Nobody can talk to the president, so the only thing left for him is destruction from the hand of the Most High God, and it is the same for the people in the congregation with pride. Pride don’t change, whether it is in the congregation, in your kids or in the government. Pride is pride, and it cannot hide.

You are in a relationship and you keep arguing all the time; you ever wonder, why do we keep bumping heads? “From whence come wars and fightings among you?” Why do we keep going back and forth with each other?

“Come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?” Something inside of you is making this conflict come up all the time. We just went over this last week, we just went over this yesterday.

“Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain”. No matter how much you fight, you have nothing; you are ready to kill and you still have nothing. That is how Donald Trump is: he has everything, and it is not enough for him.

“Ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.” You are not asking the right way, according to what God says.

“Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss”. There is a way to ask for things, and it is according to the Lord. You want peace? The Lord has to get on board for peace. Some people you are not going to have peace with. In the congregation, in relationships, in our houses, you know who the troublemaker is; you have to be honest with yourself. America has to be honest about who the troublemaker is: why gas prices are so high, why food is so high, why we are searched at the borders and airports, why there are no jobs, why life is so difficult. From the government to the congregation to your house and your marriage, be honest about who the starter is, and point them out so everybody knows. That is why we do counsel: we hear both sides and say, it is him, it is her; we let the child speak and say, you are the problem, you are the reason there is no peace.

“That ye may consume it upon your lusts.” Whatever you get is just to fulfill your lusts. You don’t care about the God we should trust, and people like that wind up in the dust. There is no future for them.

“A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.” When you keep yourself in honor, people will see you have a humble spirit, and it will uphold you. When you deal with prideful people, don’t let them change you. They walk with the devil and want to bring you down to their level. When they go low, you go high. Look down at them, step over them, keep walking, and leave them right where they are.

A wise man said, don’t argue with fools, because people from a distance can’t tell who is who. When IUIC was growing and arguing with the other camps, the bishop said, leave them alone, because the people coming in could not tell the difference. When we left them alone, people started saying, these guys right here, this is who we are following. So we don’t go back and forth with people no more.

Some people hate themselves, and that is why they cause conflict; they have no peace inside. Donald Trump, with the fake hair and the position he is in, hates himself. His name came up the most in the Epstein files, and he has a history of assaulting women. That is not a happy man. If all you can do with all your riches is declare war, assault people and tweet, something is wrong with you. Look at those types of people and move away from them, because they will bring you down into the dirt and get you hurt, and keep moving, and you will wonder how you got there. They only exist because you exist: they are always gossiping, always arguing, always have something to say back.

We find happiness in this truth, and keeping God’s laws is our proof: honoring the Sabbath and keeping it holy, the dietary law, the dress code. If your relationship is not happy, somebody there has the devil on them; there is no other answer. That is what James chapter 4 was explaining: where is it coming from? Somebody inside hates themselves and is not comfortable unless they are starting trouble. Trump is not comfortable unless he is tweeting, robbing somebody, invading some country or insulting. There is nothing good you can say he has done; his hotels failed, his planes failed, his airport, his Trump school, his relationships failed. Don’t look at the outward; look at the inward, and you will see a person who hates himself and takes it out on everybody else.

If you are having a problem in the congregation or in friendships, examine the life of that person: they are not happy. And if the scripture can’t fix them, there is nothing you can do for them. Send them on their way. When your children reach a certain age and won’t hear, tell them to start looking for a place to live: you got the damn devil on you, and you will not disrupt my peace. People doing evil are often in a place of comfort and don’t understand there is a real world out there. Donald Trump doesn’t understand there is a real world out there looking for bombs to blow that ass up. These scriptures are given to us so we can see who not to be. Prideful people never think it is them; America has a problem with everybody else, and they have no allies and no friends. From your house to the White House, pride is the same.

“Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord”: God don’t like you. You are abominable.

“Though hand join in hand”: you think you can hold hands with somebody else and not get touched by God. Some of you will defend the wicked, make excuses for the wicked, and think you can protect them.

“He shall not be unpunished.” You can have a wicked, prideful husband or wife, and when God brings judgment you are going to get your ass kicked just like your spouse. You can have a wicked child in your house, and when God sends that judgment, if you are joining hands with them trying to protect them, the Most High is going to get you too. Nobody can save you when God is setting that judgment for you. God don’t play.

precepts.why:
“He that toucheth pitch shall be defiled therewith; and he that hath fellowship with a proud man shall be like unto him.” Look at the people Donald Trump surrounds himself with.

Bondi, the Department of Justice, the highest level of justice, went before Congress over the Epstein files, with the survivors, those white women, crying behind her and asking only for an apology. She would not even turn around and acknowledge them. She deflected from every question and kept saying how great Donald Trump was and how good the economy was going. In the files the Department released, the names of the abusers, those who did the rape, the enslavement, the pedophilia, were blacked out, while the names of the women who were abused were put out for the whole public to harass them. It was her job to give those women privacy. Instead she told the members of Congress that they should be apologizing to Donald Trump. The whole world now says she was the worst prosecutor, and he had to fire her.

Look at the people who are in pride and look at their friends. They always find people who will accept them in their evil. The bishop says, show me your friends and I’ll tell you who you are. Every person Trump surrounds himself with is a kiss ass. He that hath fellowship with a proud man shall be like unto him, and though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

sense.text:
“In the punishment of the proud there is no remedy”. There is nothing you can do to remedy their pride, even when you punish them. You can fine them, you can do whatever. In relationships you say, I have done everything; with your children you discipline them and take things away. Some people there is no remedy for: they cannot see that it is them, that they need to change, that they are the cause.

“For the plant of wickedness hath taken root in him.” A wicked plant is growing inside of them, so there is no remedy, no scripture and no picture you can paint to show them they need to stop. Pride is wickedness; it is something in their soul that wants to take control and take hold of wickedness.

“The heart of the prudent will understand a parable”: if you are a prudent person, you will understand the parables of God.

“And an attentive ear is the desire of a wise man.” That is why we tell you to get your pen and your notebook out and write the scriptures. The people who are looking around, not writing and not paying attention, you already see what type of spirit is on them. They are clueless and they are useless.

“Water will quench a flaming fire; and alms maketh an atonement for sins. And he that requiteth good turns is mindful of that which may come hereafter; and when he falleth, he shall find a stay.” Because of your behavior, if you have a right heart with God, when you fall you will find a stay. We are all going to make mistakes and things will go bad for us, but there is a way so that when things go bad the Lord will sustain you.

Never get to that place of pride where God has to hide his hope from you and say, you are on your own. The same way a parent has to tell his child, you are on your own; the same way a spouse has to tell someone they love, you need to get out; the same way the world leaders are telling Donald Trump, you are on your own, you are not getting my country bombed up. Pride is deceitful, and most people in it don’t understand that they are in pride. When you correct them over and over and they don’t listen, you have to separate yourself from them.

“In the congregation of the ungodly shall a fire be kindled”: God is going to burn you up. In the beginning of the Bible, when there was a congregation of the ungodly, he drowned them; here it is fire.

“And in a rebellious nation wrath is set on fire.” That is the only thing you can do with people who are rebellious: burn them. They are not going to listen.

“He was not pacified toward the old giants”: the giants were before us, in the elder world, the leaders, and God destroyed them. “Who fell away in the strength of their foolishness.” They were giants, but they were foolish. People feel strong in their foolishness. The one who wants to commit crime and do everything evil feels emboldened and strong in his wickedness; the person with the big mouth who wants to argue and fight with everybody feels strong with that big mouth.

“Neither spared he the place where Lot sojourned, but abhorred them for their pride.” God will hate you when you are filled with pride. Tell prideful people this: there is a God, your creator, and your creator can become your hater, because God hates pride. Eventually he will look at all the people you are pissing off and say, I’m sick of you.

“He pitied not the people of perdition, who were taken away in their sins”. He is not going to have pity on you, though we like to have pity. People tell you their story, he had a rough life, she had a rough life; how long are you going to keep telling that story? A couple came for counsel: the spouse would not listen to any of the scriptures, and the one who asked for help said, you need to understand, his mother wasn’t there for him, he grew up in a foster home, his aunt was mean to him. Sir, don’t call this number no more. You called to have him corrected with the scripture; he doesn’t want the scripture, and now you are making excuses for the abuser who doesn’t want to change. Stay away.

“Nor the six hundred thousand footmen, who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts.” Six hundred thousand people gathered together in the hardness of their hearts, and God pitied them not.

“And if there be one stiffnecked among the people, it is marvel if he escape unpunished”. If you have one wicked person around you, it is a marvel if God doesn’t touch him. The wicked think, I can keep doing it and nothing is going to happen, everybody is stupid, God doesn’t see me, you are the problem, not me. One stiffnecked person in this congregation: I’ll be amazed if God lets you go. That is how much God hates pride.

“For mercy and wrath are with him; he is mighty to forgive, and to pour out displeasure.” God can be merciful or he can be vengeful against you: he will forgive, and he will pour out his displeasure. A pastor sat down with us and was told, no, God is not good all the time. Did not God drown everybody on the face of the earth? Did he not let the earth swallow people up in the days of Moses, tell Moses to kill the thousands who were giving him a hard time, and leave a generation in the wilderness for forty years and deal with the next generation? Yet they read the Bible and say, turn to your neighbor and say God is good all the time. You are a damn fool. That is not the same God that drowned everybody on the earth; the last book is the bloodiest, and he is going to burn up billions of people with fire.

A pastor asked, what type of God are you saying, that God is not good in his essence? This is the scripture for him, and for the wicked Israelite camps that think you just die and that is it: a God who, after he kills you, makes you feel more pain. Who feels pain in death?

“And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works”: by your works, by your keeping of the commandments, that is how you escape God’s wrath. “And by faith, whereby ye have believed”: by your faith in what is written in the Bible, because you believe there is a God you have to answer to and a judgment that will come to you.

“Shall be preserved from the said perils”: that is how you are preserved from the perils, from the judgment God has waiting. “And shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders”: that is when the kingdom is set up.

“For I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.” The one third of the Israelites: God already sanctified us from the beginning, from the foundation of the earth. He said, these spirits I am going to love, and these spirits I am going to reject and destroy. God is good all the time to the people that keep his commandments. You that are breaking God’s laws, he is not good to you. So don’t listen to anybody saying God is good all the time; that is not scriptural.

“Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways”. What is the abuse? You come into the school and we tell you, grow your beard, keep the Sabbath, follow the dietary law, keep the high holy days, sisters wrap your head and wear your skirt or dress, and now you are mad that we are telling you God’s ways.

“And they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.” They say, I’m not following that Israelite stuff; you bring it to your family and they say, I don’t want nothing to do with that. Torment is waiting for you. I don’t know what Bible you are reading.

“For such as in their life have received benefits”: the nice house, the car, the job, traveling, taking pictures on social media. It looks like it is all good in the hood. “And have not known me”: they don’t even know God. You are going to see people prospering in their pride who don’t know God, and start saying, I’m keeping the scriptures, I’ve got my fringes on, I’m going to work and living paycheck to paycheck.

“And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty”: these people hate following God’s laws, and they rub it in your face that they are not following them and are prospering. The liberty was us setting the example, in the street, going all over the world, for you to repent and return to God as an Israelite.

“And, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them”: we are in the streets. Out in the camp with the men, the brothers were crossing the street, running up to people with flyers, and people were dismissing them and throwing the flyers down, not stopping for five minutes, and the brothers kept aggressively trying to get people to listen. At least the Lord can’t say the camp is not trying. That is us. We open the place of repentance, so you don’t get a death sentence. It is not the Methodist, Baptist, Catholic, Jehovah’s Witness, Seventh-day Adventist or Protestant; there ain’t no repentance in those churches, and those denominations can do nothing for your salvation. They just make you feel good.

“Understood not, but despised it”. You don’t understand; we aren’t doing this because we have nothing better to do. You hate it. Tell people about the Israelites and repentance and you will see the hatred they have. They will accept anything else: I’m a born-again Christian, I’m saved, I’m washed in the blood. But show them in the scripture why Christ really died, and you see how much hatred they have. They hate us because they ain’t us.

“The same must know it after death by pain.” This is a God who will kill you and have pain waiting for you in death. So don’t listen to any stupid black Hebrew Israelite saying hell was made up by the Catholic Church. Which Catholic Church is teaching you a place of eternal suffering, going into the Apocrypha and bringing these scriptures out? And if there is one, you should be ashamed that the Catholic Church knows the Bible better than you. The Bible does not say God is good all the time. Eventually God reaches a point where it is enough, and you have to pay.

precepts.why:
That is why he said, I have sanctified them for me from the beginning. “Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee”. Where did he know us? In spirit. This is a physical domain, but he knew us in the spirit world, in another dimension. He did something to our spirit before our parents ever brought us forth. He is telling Jeremiah this.

“And before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee”. You are here because of a conversation God had with you before you even came forth into this world. You are here because God cares about you; you are not here by accident. There is something in your spirit that God said, I need to fix, so that when the time comes to destroy the earth, you are going to come back to me, and not be in your pride.

sense.text: These are examples of what God does to the proud. This is when the Assyrians were trying to attack the Israelites, and the Assyrian general came to tell the Israelites, you better give in, don’t try and fight. The king of Assyria sent them “with a great host against Jerusalem”: they came with a big army against Jerusalem.

“Speak ye now to Hezekiah”: Hezekiah was the king. Go tell King Hezekiah, “Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria”, this is what the king of Assyria says to you Israelites: “What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?” Where are you getting this confidence to stand against us? You know who we are?

“Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,)”: your words are vain. “I have counsel and strength for the war”: look at my military. Ain’t Donald Trump saying the same thing? Look at my military.

“Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?” Who is this you trust, this God of Israel? You have the nerve to rebel against me? Do you know who I am?

“Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it”. You don’t have no support; what you are leaning on will break. They trusted in the king of Egypt also.

“Is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away”: Hezekiah tried to reform the Israelites when they were in sin. It is like the people who say to us, I’m sick of that Bible, you think you people are the first to ever come with that Bible? Hezekiah had been trying to get you to serve your God and you rebelled. Do you think your God is going to defend you now, when your own king Hezekiah couldn’t get you wicked people to submit? This is what the heathen is saying to Israel.

“Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria”: honor the king of Assyria. “And I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.” If you have the men to ride them, we will give you two thousand horses. Just give up.
“Am I now come up without the Lord against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.” He said God told him to destroy you people.

They asked him to speak in the Syrian language and not in the Jews’ language in the ears of the people on the wall, but he said, don’t tell me how to speak to you people. “Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words?” Y’all better bow down to us; we are going to destroy you.

“That they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?” My master told me you people are going to eat s-h-i-t; that is what dung is. People get mad on Clubhouse when that is spelled out, but the Bible uses that reference all the time.
He “cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language”. He was asked to speak in the Assyrian tongue, and he said no, I am talking to you in a language you understand.

“Let not Hezekiah deceive you”: don’t listen to your king. “Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us”. That is what they try to do with us now. Things are getting bad, and our job is to tell you, God is going to deliver us. It was the same when the enemy attacked then: you believe in this Israelite stuff? You think your God is going to come and deliver you?

“Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern”. That is the same thing they are going to do to us when they afflict us: you want to eat good, stay in your house, have everything? Leave this Israelite stuff alone, make an allegiance with us, and life will be good for you.

“Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land”: or I will take you away from all the comforts you have now. What they threaten is your resources. That is why the bishop tells you to start putting food away, because they are going to threaten the things that sustain us. They know how people are: once you cut off their food and their water, they humble themselves and give in, and turn their back on God.

“Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?” America can say the same: who was able to stand against America? Nobody. Where was your God when we put you on cargo slave ships? White man Jesus didn’t save you; now you think a black Jesus can? He is calling out all the gods, “Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad?”, saying none of them could stop us, so what makes you think your God can save you?

“But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.” That is why the bishop said, don’t do interviews with these people. We don’t have to answer you or say nothing to you, because we know the pride of thine heart hath deceived thee.
When king Hezekiah heard it, “he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.” He humbled himself and went into prayer.

He sent “to Isaiah the prophet”. He went and called Isaiah. “This day is a day of trouble”: you always go to the priests when trouble comes. King Hezekiah went to the priests. A government always had spiritual advisers; America has no spiritual adviser. The king got threatened and said, go get Isaiah. When the nation of Israel is threatened, you get the general, Bishop Nathanyel.

“It may be the Lord thy God will hear all the words of Rab–shakeh”: God is listening to all the words. He was sent “to reproach the living God”: God heard you disrespecting the living God. “Wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left”: go and pray for the remnant, because this man was talking crazy about the living God.

“Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me. Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land”. Isaiah said, I already spoke to God, and it is not going to work out for this man.

“And I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.” He is going to get his ass kicked; that is what it means to fall by the sword. The only people who can tell you that are the priests, not no military and not no president.

Rab-shakeh found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, and the king heard “of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee”. When he came back, his people were already at war. The Lord already set it off, so that people started attacking them. That is the same thing happening to the United States of America: they have been attacking God’s chosen people, and now nations they never expected are attacking them. We know from the scriptures that Russia and China are going to get involved. This is history repeating itself: while they are running their mouth against the Israelites, God is already setting up ambushes against them from other nations.
Hezekiah spread the letter before the Lord and prayed: “hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.” Listen to this man running his mouth about you.

“That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.” Understand this: Hezekiah prayed to God by himself, and Isaiah came and told him, God heard your prayer. That is why you need good leaders and strong men of faith around you.

“This is the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning him”. God did not answer Hezekiah directly; God went to Isaiah and said, this is what I am going to do. “The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee”: God don’t like you, Sennacherib. “And laughed thee to scorn”: she is laughing at you.

“Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.” Translation: who do you think you are talking to?

“Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there”. He is not going to bust one shot here; he is not even coming into this city. This is how gangster God is. “Nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it”: he is not even going to get close to you. I don’t care how big his army is, he is not coming here.

“By the way that he came, by the same shall he return”: the way he came is the way he is going back. “For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.” That is why we have to honor our forefathers: God has a relationship with our forefathers before us.

“And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the Lord went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand”. He sent one angel, and one angel killed 185,000 men of war in one night. “When they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses”: nothing but dead bodies as far as the eye could see. God said, oh, you are running your mouth? I got something for you. One angel overnight wiped out the whole army, almost two hundred thousand men.

Sennacherib went back to Nineveh, “and it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword”. He was worshipping his god, after he had just said our God was nothing, and God let his own kids kill him after he ran his mouth. That is how God sends strange punishments on the proud.

“And they escaped into the land of Armenia.” God let his kids get away with it. God will let your own family members cause harm to you for running your mouth. This is the God we serve.

This is Nebuchadnezzar running his mouth. “Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof”: he changed Daniel’s name to Belteshazzar, and he knew Daniel could interpret dreams.

“All the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation”. The same way Trump don’t got advisers, the other kings of the earth don’t have advisers. We have the advisers; we understand scripture to paint the picture. So he says, Daniel, my advisers can’t help me; what does your God say about this dream?

“The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven”, with meat for all and “under which the beasts of the field dwelt”. He is telling the king that he is a tree nourishing all the other people, and he calls them beasts. “It is thou, O king, that art grown and become strong”.
“Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth”. He is telling him, you as a tree are going to be cut down, and only a stump is going to be left.

“This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the most High”. Daniel told him, you are a great tree, but God is going to cut you down. He was warning him in the dream.

“Till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men”: God is going to humble you until you understand you are only empowered because of him. “And giveth it to whomsoever he will”: you only rule because God put you there to rule. Daniel warned him in the dream, and he didn’t listen.
“Thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.” God had to teach him a lesson, because he thought he was the most powerful.

“Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee”: listen to what I just explained to you; it was a warning. “And break off thy sins by righteousness”: stop sinning. “And thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.” If you are good to the people, God will extend your kingdom.

“At the end of twelve months”, a year after Daniel told him the dream, he walked in the palace and said, “Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?” He said it pridefully: look how great Babylon is by my power and my might. Look how great I am.

“While the word was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven”: while he was still running his mouth. That is how God would talk if he was here. “O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.” Just like that, God can turn you upside down. Look at Trump with his mouth; you would think he would read this Bible and stop running his mouth. A whole year later, God was still listening to him talk. We think God is not listening to us, but as long as the words were still in his mouth, he turned him into an animal.

“They shall make thee to eat grass as oxen”: like an animal, on the floor. “And seven times shall pass over thee”: that is the length of time he is going to stay there, until God feels he has been punished enough. “Until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men”. That is what we keep telling people: humble yourself before God. Bring your ass down. But some people don’t get the picture until the picture is drawn. “And giveth it to whomsoever he will”: God can set up anybody and take anybody down.

“The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar”. God turned him into an animal, “till his hairs were grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.” He grew long fingernails, just because he was running his mouth and got beside himself in pride.

“And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven”. God humbled him: looking like a filthy animal on the floor, looking up to the heavens. That is what is going to happen to all of you if you don’t humble yourself. If you are lucky you just get sick and recover; some of you are going to lift up your eyes in hell, like the rich man who lifted up his eyes in hell and asked for help and was told there is a gulf between us. But Nebuchadnezzar, reduced to an animal in the grass, looked up to heaven, “and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High”.

“And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing”. God brought him back to his senses when he realized, you are nothing, Nebuchadnezzar. All your armies, all your military is nothing. All God has to do is touch one man, or send one angel and almost two hundred thousand die. One man turned into an animal because of his pride. “At the same time my reason returned unto me”.

“Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.” So don’t let your pride pull you aside from God. God is listening to everything we say, and he don’t play.

“Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church. And he killed James the brother of John with the sword. And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also.” The government is going to attack us, and there are going to be black people who are happy for the attack. The Roman government attacked the Israelites because it pleased the Jews. So don’t think the same people we are passing our flyers to won’t join with the government.

“(Then were the days of unleavened bread.)” It was on Passover. He didn’t care that it was the highest holy day. Christ was killed on Passover, and Peter was arrested on Passover. They waited for the most holy day to go and attack the Israelites.

“Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.” When things go wrong, you need the right people to pray for you. Imagine we get snatched up on Passover, or something happens to the men traveling all over on Passover: we want you praying, talking to God without ceasing. That is why you don’t keep prideful people around you, because they are not going to do it; you can’t rely on them. The church prayed that Peter would be preserved, because Herod was killing people, and doing it for the wicked Israelites who aligned themselves with the government, just like the wicked Israelites now who are for Donald Trump.

“The same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.” Herod was coming for him; he had soldiers watching him and Peter in chains.

“And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison”, and “his chains fell off from his hands.” You are in prison, in chains, asleep, and the angel says, wake up, put your garment on, and the chains come off. Peter followed him “and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.” He couldn’t believe what he was going through; Peter thought he was going to die.

“When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord”. He walked through the different sections of the prison, like a prison break where they pass all the gates, with the gates opening by themselves and an angel walking with him. “And forthwith the angel departed from him”: just like that, you are on your own.

“And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.” The government and his own people were trying to kill him. It is the same now: the government is going to turn against us, and wicked black people, Hispanic people, people in the Caribbean and in Africa, who are being shown they are the people of the book and refuse to look, are going to turn on us. All we have is the prayer of the church and the angels answering those prayers.

“Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.” Everybody was talking about it: you let Peter go? Herod “examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death.” Just like that, kill them.
Tyre and Sidon “desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.” Same thing with America: they nourish all the islands of the Caribbean, so they protect them.

After Peter escapes, “Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.” He sits on his throne in elegance. “And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.” It is the same thing: Donald Trump, he is the savior, he is not like any other man, God bless Donald Trump and America.

“And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory”. You think there is not a God listening? God said, what did he say? Go kill him. These are empires that have nothing to do with God, and God is still listening to them talk. He turned Nebuchadnezzar into an animal; he killed Sennacherib for running his mouth that he was going to touch the Israelites; Herod put Peter in prison, ran his mouth, and God sent an angel to kill him.

“And he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.” God put him in the dirt. That was his honor on earth, his legacy.

“About that time came Antiochus with dishonour out of the country of Persia”. He went to rob the temple at Persepolis and was put to flight and “returned with shame.” Then at Ecbatane “news was brought him what had happened unto Nicanor and Timotheus”: Antiochus hears that God brought forth the destruction of Nicanor.

“He thought to avenge upon the Jews the disgrace done unto him by those that made him flee.” He was mad at the other country that defeated him, so he said, I’m taking it out on the Jews.

“For he had spoken proudly in this sort, That he would come to Jerusalem and make it a common burying place of the Jews.” Another one running his mouth: I’m going to turn Jerusalem into a graveyard.

“But the Lord Almighty”, the God of Israel, “smote him with an incurable and invisible plague”. Here is a man riding in his chariot, I’m going to get them, and all of a sudden, stop the chariot, what is this? It was not something visible he could see; he just started feeling pain. That is why you get nervous when things start hurting out of nowhere.

“As soon as he had spoken these words”: God was listening to his words. In each of these instances your mouth brought the destruction on you. That is why you have to watch people who don’t know how to shut up; you keep telling them over and over, stop running your mouth, and they can’t listen. There is a God that is listening.

“A pain of the bowels that was remediless came upon him, and sore torments of the inner parts”. Imagine cramps in your stomach with no Tylenol, no aspirin, no remedy for the pain. Like the pain a woman gets at that time of the month, where she can’t move, multiplied by ten; except this pain is not going away.

“And that most justly: for he had tormented other men’s bowels with many and strange torments.” God said, I’m going to make you feel pain there, because you did that to other men. The same thing you do to other people, I’m going to make you feel. You did strange things to hurt people, so I’m bringing a strange sickness, while his chariots and soldiers were all preparing for war.

“Howbeit he nothing at all ceased from his bragging”: he kept running his mouth while he was in pain. Some people are just that stupid; everything is going wrong for them and they are still running their mouth and not listening. “But still was filled with pride, breathing out fire in his rage against the Jews”: still saying what he is going to do to God’s chosen people while everything goes wrong around him.

“And commanding to haste the journey”: move faster. “But it came to pass that he fell down from his chariot, carried violently; so that having a sore fall, all the members of his body were much pained.” Imagine a whole army moving and someone shouting, the king just fell, everybody stop.

“And thus he that a little afore thought he might command the waves of the sea”: he thought he could command the sea with his mouth, “so proud was he beyond the condition of man”. Now he “was now cast on the ground, and carried in an horselitter, shewing forth unto all the manifest power of God.” They carried him off the ground in a horse litter, a thing used to pick up crap.

“So that the worms rose up out of the body of this wicked man”: now he had worms coming out of him. “His flesh fell away”: his skin started to rot. “And the filthiness of his smell was noisome to all his army.” Everybody in the army: what is that smell? Can somebody go wash him up?

“And the man, that thought a little afore he could reach to the stars of heaven”: he had that much pride. “No man could endure to carry for his intolerable stink.” Nobody wanted to be around him. Imagine God doing that to you: nobody can come and help you or bring you food because of how you smell. That is dishonorable.

“Here therefore, being plagued, he began to leave off his great pride, and to come to the knowledge of himself by the scourge of God, his pain increasing every moment.” Every moment it got worse and worse. Don’t play with God.

“And when he himself could not abide his own smell”: it’s you, king, you’re the one that smells. “He said these words, It is meet to be subject unto God”. Now he is humbled. You see how people are? When that pain hits just right, because God knows every person. Some people get touched once and straighten up; they are not doing nothing wrong no more, and they are the first one here every Sabbath, because they got touched once. Some of you, God has to bring this low so you can know where you need to go.

“And that a man that is mortal should not proudly think of himself”. You are mortal. Stop bigging yourself up like you are something bigger than you are.
“This wicked person vowed also unto the Lord, who now no more would have mercy upon him”. He was past mercy. He had a chance before, but now God said, no mercy for you, and now he is making vows.

The holy city “he would set at liberty”: he says, I’ll let all the Israelites go, just take this away from me. “And as touching the Jews, whom he had judged not worthy so much as to be buried, but to be cast out with their children to be devoured of the fowls and wild beasts”: he had said, don’t even bury the Jews, leave them in the street to rot. That is why God is letting him rot and stink the way a dead person does. He wanted the Jews to rot, so God let him rot. He is already dead and doesn’t even know it.

“Yea, and that also he would become a Jew himself, and go through all the world that was inhabited”. I don’t want to be a white man no more, I’m ready to join the Israelites and tell them about you. That is when the torment touched him: all of a sudden you want to be born again and be God’s friend.

“But for all this his pains would not cease: for the just judgment of God was come upon him”. God said, no, you are going to pay for this one. You were running your mouth; now you are going to learn what God is about. “He wrote unto the Jews the letter underwritten, containing the form of a supplication”: now he is asking the Jews for help.

“Antiochus, king and governor, to the good Jews his citizens wisheth much joy, health, and prosperity”. Now you are good Jews. Look how his voice just changed; it is all sweet talk now. “As for me, I was weak, or else I would have remembered kindly your honour and good will”: if God hadn’t done this to me, I would have been nice to you; I didn’t want to hurt you. “And being taken with a grievous disease, I thought it necessary to care for the common safety of all”: I care about you guys.

“But considering that even my father, at what time he led an army into the high countries”, appointed a successor, “I have appointed my son Antiochus king”. He is blaming his father for everything: look, I didn’t want to do this.

“Therefore I pray and request you to remember the benefits that I have done unto you”: now he says, remember I was nice to you. The man was just coming to kill them, and he is blaming his daddy. “And that every man will be still faithful to me and my son.”

“Thus the murderer and blasphemer having suffered most grievously, as he entreated other men, so died he a miserable death in a strange country in the mountains.” That was beautiful. He died a miserable death in a strange country while he was begging God. All praises to the Most High God of Israel.
“Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God”: that is the message of the whole class. “That he may exalt you in due time”: he will raise us up in due time.

“Casting all your care upon him”: everything that is going wrong, put it on the Most High God. “For he careth for you.” He cares about us. Don’t let anybody take you in any direction other than that God cares. We are here because God cares.
“Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”. Esau is the devil, and he is looking about for whom he may devour.

“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. Edom is the Caucasian people today, whom we call Babylon, under Donald Trump’s rule. This is a vision God sees about them.

“An ambassador is sent among the heathen”: among the other nations. “Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.” That is why all the nations of the earth are getting ready to attack the United States of America.

“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen”: they are the minority, but they call everybody else the minority. They are small among the other nations.

“Thou art greatly despised.” The other nations hate you. In case you didn’t know it, the other nations hate you. Stop saying we are racist and don’t like you; God said the other nations hate you.

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”: that is why they hate you, because you are full of pride and you push God to the side.

“Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: they come from the Caucasus mountains, of Georgia and Russia. God told us their dwelling place. “Whose habitation is high”: that is why they live in the skyscrapers and the penthouse apartments where the richest people are.

“That saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” Is that not what Donald Trump is saying? We have the strongest military, there is no way you can hide from us, we can invade any country, we don’t need your help; you have three days to open the Strait of Hormuz, you have one week, this is your last warning, we are coming for you. And the Arabs say, Allahu Akbar, come, Mr. Donald Trump, we are waiting for you. They don’t care. The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: that is what they have on their military, the eagle; on their postal trucks, the eagle; on the back of their dollar bill, the eagle. That is what they said when they landed on the moon: the eagle has landed.

“And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: we are going to go to a place where mankind never dwelt. “Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” America is going down. Twelve tribes, worldwide.
